question: 只看等级 3 的客户，按分支统计 2014 年佣金收入，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2014 AND dc.Tier = 3 GROUP BY db.Branch ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
等值过滤载体：等级 3 客户（Tier = 3）
营业部/分支是组织的子单元（OMG Commons）
